message: my ex was calling me (i have sbc) with no problem, but his mom has att and he couldn't call her. she was told to buy the prepaid phone card, which she did, and that her number would be the only number he could call. he cannot get through to her and now he can't call me either. i think her best bet is to switch phone service to sbc or cancel her account with t-netix. has anyone had any luck canceling their account? help appreciated.
